name: 产品动图（多格帧图合成 GIF/WebP 动效）

prompt_template.type: 16-frame contact sheet for stop-motion style product animation, arranged as a 4x4 grid, frames read left-to-right top-to-bottom
prompt_template.subject: {product_description}, identical to reference image across ALL 16 frames: same shape, color, logo, label, lighting
prompt_template.motion: camera orbits the product {orbit_direction} by 60 degrees total across the sequence (start 30 degrees left, end 30 degrees right), product stays centered and stationary, background elements slide horizontally to convey rotation
prompt_template.grid: equal square cells, consistent margins, consistent lighting from frame 1 to frame 16, no frame borders or numbering
prompt_template.quality: consistent product identity across frames, smooth incremental change between adjacent frames, commercial e-commerce quality

defaults.output_note: generate the 16-frame grid ONCE, then slice cells and composite into GIF/WebP offline (see references/motion-gif.md for the full pipeline: grid -> slice -> loop -> compress)

loop-orbit.description: 环绕展示（电商主图/详情页首图默认）

overrides.motion: camera orbits 60 degrees left-to-right, motion eases in slow at the start and faster at the end so the reversed playback loops seamlessly

highlight-turn.description: 产品自身小幅动作（翻盖/旋转功能件）

overrides.motion: the product's {moving_part} moves through one full action cycle across the frames, camera fully locked, background static

platform_constraints: final deliverable under 3MB for WeChat/detail-page embed; transparent residues must be solid pixels in GIF (no semi-transparency); prefer WebP when transparency is needed
